title: Uttarakhand Assembly 2027

BJP.note: incumbent since 2017; UK has never re-elected a government before 2022's BJP repeat

poll_corrections.rule: class-level corrections from measured UK poll errors (2014-22 cycles): bjp_led +1.38, rival -1.82 after n/(n+2) shrinkage; see data/processed/pollster_corrections.csv

resolution.source: Election Commission of India official results (results.eci.gov.in), party-wise seat tally at first full declaration of all 70 seats
rules: Bloc seat totals = sum of seats won by the member parties listed in `blocs` as composed at freeze; post-result defections, mergers and letters of support are ignored
If an alliance splits BEFORE polling, a re-run forecast (new ledger rows) supersedes; these rows still resolve against freeze-time bloc composition
'wins majority' = bloc seats >= 36 of 70 at first full declaration; countermanded/postponed seats count as not won unless they decide the question, in which case resolution waits for them
'is largest' = strictly more seats than every other modeled bloc (independents and unmodeled parties are not blocs); an exact tie resolves NO for all blocs
Seat-threshold questions resolve on the same official tally
If the election is not held by 2027-12-31, rows resolve VOID: logged and excluded from scoring, never silently dropped

quality_flags: All three vote-share polls are unrated agencies and they disagree on the leader (Poll Mitra has INC ahead; TNN/Vote Vibe have BJP). Seat polls disagree even more (BJP 29-54 of 70).
No AAP/UKD vote-share lines in any poll; both are treated as background others.
M3 BSP line missing from all polls - BSP questions run effectively on M2 plus baseline.
